gain_definition: external food odor response gain: Poisson drive Hz=odor_drive_before_state_hz*gain; no change to synaptic weights or postsynaptic gain
gain_provenance: engineering choices fixed before runs; neither a measured starvation ratio nor an sNPF biophysical model
odor_population: prefix:ORN_DM1,prefix:ORN_VA2; engineering food-odor proxy, not odor-receptor concentration binding
interventions: only state gain on driven ORNs; original AL topology and weights, no STD, no threshold adaptation, no OFF-triggered reset
measurements: 1ms forced spikes and total spikes for driven ORN, other ORN, all ORN, PN/eLN/GABA
50ms sum of absolute emitted ORN synaptic jumps by source and target group (not postsynaptic effective current)
individual ORN/PN/LN cumulative counts at fixed boundaries; individual OFF19-20s rate, nonzero cell count and maximum
PN and ORN first/second peak10/50, first late500, OFF1/20, reOFF1

criteria.PN_hungry_peak_higher: strictly > satiated at both 10/50ms widths; report paired differences and ratios, not merely pass label
criteria.PN_reon: second peak50 > first OFF20s AND second peaks both >=70% own first peaks; meaningful recovery requires quiet OFF20s as well
criteria.overall: all four paired seeds pass PN ordering, quiet OFF1/20/reOFF1 in both states, and reon in both states; retain ONlate as raw measurement
criteria.sensor_gate: external forced spikes exactly 0 throughout OFF; separately report all-ORN actual mean/max and outgoing transmission; do not equate low population mean with absence of active cells

OFF_candidate_screen.peak: largest of four fixed non-overlapping 50ms bins in first 200ms after OFF
OFF_candidate_screen.interpretation: exploratory candidates only; no matched continued-odor control, therefore not validated OFF coding or absence in biology
